cohort: 61,634 live births in Maringa, Parana, Brazil, between 2000 and 2013
finding: Prematurity increased from 7.9% in 2000 to 11.2% in 2013, with a growing share of moderate preterm births (32 to <37 weeks), which rose from 7.0% in 2000 to 9.7% in 2013.
mod_finding: A growing trend was observed for C-section birth (2.38% yearly increase).
